values.note: City Campground: $15 a night with electric, $8 without. RV Park: $20 a night, $119 a week, $500 a month (weekly and monthly paid in advance and approved by the Public Works Director). More than 4 adults on a site: $2 per extra person. $5 penalty for not registering on arrival. Read 2026-11-03.

values.note: The RV Park is unavailable from two weeks before Labor Day through September 30 for events at the Tri-State Rodeo Arena (Rodeo Ticket Office 319-372-2550 for camping then). The city gives no opening or closing dates otherwise.

note: City of Fort Madison camping in Rodeo Park, two areas sharing one office phone: the RV Park (2103 303rd Ave), a loop of gravel pull-throughs in open grass just north of the Tri-State Rodeo arena, and the City Campground (2134 302nd Ave), electric and non-electric sites with a shower building. Disc golf, trails, dog park and shelters in the park. --Claude
summary: Read the city's campground page: FCFS self-registration confirmed; fees now $15 (City Campground electric) to $20 (RV Park), with $8 non-electric, weekly/monthly in fees.note; showers added; the RV Park's rodeo blackout (two weeks before Labor Day - Sept 30) recorded as a season note. Open outside rodeo time: yes, the page closes it only for that window. Hookups left (the page states only the City Campground's 20/30-amp pedestals).
flags: TWO CAMPGROUNDS ON ONE PAGE: the city lists a 'CITY CAMPGROUND' (2134 302nd Ave; 10 pedestals 20-amp, 10 pedestals 30-amp; shower; $15/$8) and an 'RV PARK' (2103 303rd Ave; $20; closed for the rodeo). The stored entry mixed them: its name and note (full hookups by the rodeo arena, rodeo closure) describe the RV Park, its $15 fee the City Campground. They are ~400-500 m apart inside Rodeo Park on different streets; under the ~1 km split line, so I kept one entry covering both and said so in the note.

PIN ~465 m OFF: stored 40.65010,-91.31920 is in the open rodeo field south of the arena. Imagery shows the RV Park's loop of angled gravel pull-throughs (about 12-16 pads) immediately north of the arena at about 40.6542,-91.3182; suggest that. The City Campground's sites were not resolved on imagery (a wooded park drive ~350 m west, around 40.654,-91.3226, may be it; unconfirmed).

UNVERIFIED HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 / water / sewer (derived from old note prose: '~20 full-hookup RV sites (water/electric/sewer, 30/50 amp)') are not stated on the city page, which gives hookups only for the City Campground (20/30-amp pedestals, no water/sewer mentioned). Left as derived; the city does not confirm full hookups or 50 amp at the RV Park.
SEASON: stored year_round false came from the rodeo blackout, not a stated season; the city gives no open/close dates. Left as is with the blackout in season.note.
LONG-STAY (public, informational): the RV Park sells $500 monthly stays, approved by the Public Works Director; nightly FCFS is the default. Not a criteria issue for a city park.
FIT: no length limits stated; the RV Park pads are long gravel pull-throughs on imagery. A 23-ft motorhome fits.
NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: upland park, no water near either area.
NOTE: dropped the full-hookup/30-50 amp, FCFS/registration, weekly/monthly and rodeo-closure text (fields carry them, or the city does not state them).
